spell.castamir.dardo_ombra.name: Shadow Bolt
spell.castamir.dardo_ombra.description: Hurls a bolt of shadow, dealing {damage} soul spell damage.
spell.castamir.drenaggio_vitale.name: Life Drain
spell.castamir.drenaggio_vitale.descript: Drains the target for {damage} soul spell damage, healing you for {heal}.
spell.castamir.maledizione.name: Curse
spell.castamir.maledizione.description: Curses the target: {damage} soul spell damage and Wither {effect_amplifier} for {effect_duration} seconds.
spell.castamir.nube_tenebra.name: Cloud of Darkness
spell.castamir.nube_tenebra.description: A cloud of darkness surrounds you: enemies inside take {damage} soul spell damage per second, blinded and slowed.
spell.castamir.globo_ombra.name: Shadow Orb
spell.castamir.globo_ombra.description: Hurls an orb of shadow that explodes on impact: {damage} soul spell damage to the target and those nearby.
spell.castamir.raggio_abisso.name: Abyssal Beam
spell.castamir.raggio_abisso.description: Channels a beam from the abyss dealing {damage} soul spell damage while held.
spell.castamir.marchio_rovina.name: Mark of Ruin
spell.castamir.marchio_rovina.descriptio: Marks the target: Weakness {effect_amplifier} and Slowness for {effect_duration} seconds; visible through walls.
item.castamir.spell_book/mago_nero.spell: Spell Book of Black Mages: three damage spells and three curses, learned at the Spell Binding Table.
